requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear a declaration of the name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer, as applicable.

applicability.condition: Required on all pre-packaged commodities without exception.

notes: Must include full postal address with PIN code. For imported goods, the importer's Indian address is required in addition to the foreign manufacturer.

requirement: For imported commodities, a declaration of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly, as the case may be, shall be made on the package.

applicability.condition: Mandatory ONLY if the product is imported, manufactured, or assembled outside India. Not applicable to domestically manufactured products.

legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(aa), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (inserted by amendment)
notes: The system will apply this rule only when 'is_imported' flag is set or importer address is detected. Otherwise marks as NOT_APPLICABLE.

requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity.
notes: Must allow consumer to identify the commodity. Brand name alone does not satisfy this requirement.

requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear the net quantity, in terms of standard units of weights and measures, of the commodity contained in the package.

applicability.condition: Required on all pre-packaged commodities. Units must follow the Second Schedule of the Legal Metrology Act.

legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; Second Schedule, Legal Metrology Act, 2009
notes: Standard units: g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, number (Nos.). Abbreviations must be standard. Approximate quantities ('approx.', 'about') may not be permitted without specific provision.

requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed or imported, as the case may be.
notes: Format: MM/YYYY or Month YYYY. Acceptable abbreviations: Mfg., Mfd., Packed, Imported. Full date is acceptable if month and year are clearly present.

requirement: For commodities with a defined shelf life or which are perishable, a declaration of 'Best Before' or 'Use By' or 'Expiry Date' shall be made.

applicability.condition: Mandatory for all packaged food commodities. Conditional for cosmetics/personal care products with shelf life of 30 months or less (PAO symbol may apply). Not applicable for durable household commodities.

legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 (for food items)
notes: Accepted labels: 'Best Before', 'BB', 'Use By', 'Expiry Date', 'Exp.'. System marks as NOT_APPLICABLE for household commodities.

requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear the maximum retail price (inclusive of all taxes) at which the commodity in the package may be sold to the ultimate consumer.

applicability.condition: Required on all pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale.

notes: Must state 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes'. Currency: ₹ or Rs. accepted. Printed MRP must match or exceed any promotional price sticker placed on the package.

requirement: For packages where net quantity exceeds 1 kilogram or 1 litre, or for multi-unit packages, the unit sale price (price per standard unit of measurement) shall be declared.

applicability.condition: Applicable for packages where the net content exceeds 1 kg or 1 litre, or multi-piece packages. Check amendment GSR 779(E) for current thresholds.

notes: The exact threshold conditions for USP applicability should be verified against the latest official gazette. System marks as CONDITIONAL and applies heuristically based on detected net quantity. System flags MANUAL_REVIEW if net quantity is borderline.

requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear the name, address and telephone number or toll-free number and email address of the consumer care, where such details are available.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(f), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended)
notes: Must include at minimum: contact number (phone or toll-free) or email. Address may reference the manufacturer address. System checks for phone number pattern and/or email pattern in extracted text.

requirement: For commodities sold by size, dimensions, or area (e.g. foil, cloth, blankets, carpets), the relevant dimension (length × width, area) shall be declared.

applicability.condition: Applicable ONLY to household commodities sold by dimension or area such as foil wrap, fabric, carpets, sheets, etc. System applies only if product_sub_type indicates a dimension-based commodity.

notes: Most household commodities do not require dimensions. System marks NOT_APPLICABLE by default unless dimension-sold flag is set.
